songs.title: O Come, All Ye Faithful (tune ADESTE FIDELES)

license.text: Placed in the public domain by the typesetter (Mutopia 'Public Domain' license).

source.attribution: Typeset by Steve Dunlop for the Mutopia Project (Mutopia-2008/01/13-1220); source www.cyberhymnal.org
source.notes: SATB on two staves (upper = S+A, lower = T+B). One-beat pickup. Source MIDI tempo is 60 qpm; overridden to 100 qpm for play. Proofread correction (options.corrections): this edition gives the refrain's first 'O come, let us adore Him' the pitches of the second (B B A B C B A); the tune sings it from the tonic (G G F# G A G D), as in Wade's Cantus Diversi (1751, Mutopia 367) and standard hymnals. Soprano and alto share that line in unison (tenor and bass rest), so one fix covers both.

corrections.why: Refrain line 1 ('O come, let us adore Him') starts on the tonic; the edition copied line 2's pitches. Source: Mutopia 367 (Cantus Diversi, 1751).

songs.title: Carol of the Bells (Shchedryk)
songs.composer: Mykola Leontovych (1916), arranged for Go Go HarmoniYo

source.notes: Our own three-voice arrangement of public-domain material from Mykola Leontovych's 'Shchedryk' (1916): the four-note ostinato and the melodic phrases (checked against a transcription of his setting). Bass and inner parts, form, interlude and ending are ours; no English words and no later arrangement used. Arranged by the S5 agent (GitHub Copilot, Claude Opus 5.5), 2026-10-25. AI-generated (CC0); owner resemblance review pending.
